title: Run trace entry
description: One tick of the loop's run trace, appended to .allium-loop/<slug>.trace.jsonl. A snapshot of the convergence state that tick, drawn from the phases' typed records. The trace makes the run's trajectory observable, so a loop that has quietly stopped converging can be seen and surfaced instead of grinding silently.

tick.description: the tick this entry records, from 1

tests.description: the tick's test result; carried forward from the last run if tests did not run this tick

weed.description: the tick's weed verdict, carried forward if weed did not run

uncovered_obligations.description: count from propagate; 0 when coverage is complete

durations_s.description: best-effort wall-clock seconds per phase this tick, from Bash timestamps; optional
